comment: The dependency policy gate — enforced by tools/check-deps.mjs (CI) and mirrored by @m0saic/platform's TEMPLATE_REPO_DEP_ALLOWLIST (a monorepo test keeps the two in lockstep). Template code may import ONLY these packages/builtins — exactly what the hosts (CLI + Desktop) already ship: the @m0saic/* substrate and the node builtins below. A native or third-party runtime dependency is a founder decision, never a per-PR addition; anything else needs a curator-approved per-file exception below.

exceptions.reason: build tool (writes template-manifest.json) — not template runtime code
read-only existsSync probe of the bundled Community M mark — the front door falls back to the brand M when the mint has not baked one (same shape as the multi-panel-figure demo-charts probe)
read-only existsSync probe of the bundled demo charts (asar-translated paths)
read-only readFileSync of the user-supplied diagramPath (.mmd/.mermaid text) — the pack's single fs touch, behind the template's fs.read capability

mermaid flowchart is DISCONNECTED (2026-09-07) — not registered by the publisher and not in template-registry.ts, so it ships nowhere. dagre is a devDependency only; a per-file exception keeps the source compiling and its tests running without putting @dagrejs/dagre into the repo-wide allowlist (which would also force it into apps/mosaic). Drop this exception when dagre is vendored and the template is re-registered.
